records.source: The goal is a tool installed, logged in and marked READY with no terminal used. records.source: WHAT IS NOT HERE, AND WHY. Local MEAN and local GAUSSIAN thresholding are not offered again: they are the Adaptive threshold mode, which runs the organelle engine's ``adaptive`` branch with a block size and an offset. Local OTSU is not offered again either: it is the "Local threshold (uneven illumination)" switch in plain Otsu mode, used by whole-image detection. Other named thresholds ignore saved Local Otsu and class-count settings; Multi-Otsu alone uses the selected class count and band in both scopes. Plain Otsu retains its legacy magnifier preprocessing, while the other thresholds use the whole-image engine on the requested crop. Niblack uses ``T = m - k*s``; Sauvola uses ``T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1))``, where ``m`` and ``s`` are the local mean and standard deviation. The engine supplies float32 values without rescaling their range, so scikit-image's default Sauvola ``R`` is 1. These formulas are different, and changing the intensity scale can change Sauvola's result.

records.source: Legacy filter failures are logged and skipped unless ``strict`` is set. PSF/restoration failures and cancellation propagate so detection cannot silently use an unprocessed image when an explicitly calibrated operation was requested. This is reached from a mouse-move (the readout under the cursor) and from the magnifier, so an exception here is one per mouse event: a missing optional package filled the console with tracebacks once (PyWavelets, 2026-09-22) and made the screen unusable. The detector then reads the image as far as the chain got, and the log says which step was dropped. A plate run passes ``strict=True``: a mask made from an image a step was silently dropped from would be presented as the mask the settings asked for.
records.context: Legacy filter failures are logged and skipped unless ``strict`` is set. PSF/restoration failures and cancellation propagate so detection cannot silently use an unprocessed image when an explicitly calibrated operation was requested. This is reached from a mouse-move (the readout under the cursor) and from the magnifier, so an exception here is one per mouse event: a missing optional package filled the console with tracebacks once (PyWavelets, 2026-09-22) and made the screen unusable. The detector then reads the image as far as the chain got, and the log says which step was dropped. A plate run passes ``strict=True``: a mask made from an image a step was silently dropped from would be presented as the mask the settings asked for.
records.translation: Falhas de filtros legados são registradas no log e ignoradas, a menos que ``strict`` esteja definido. Falhas de PSF/restauração e o cancelamento se propagam, para que a detecção não possa usar silenciosamente uma imagem não processada quando uma operação calibrada foi solicitada explicitamente. Isto é alcançado a partir de um movimento do mouse (a leitura sob o cursor) e da lupa, então uma exceção aqui significa uma por evento de mouse: um pacote opcional ausente já encheu o console de tracebacks (PyWavelets, 2026-09-22) e deixou a tela inutilizável. O detector então lê a imagem até onde a cadeia chegou, e o log diz qual etapa foi descartada. A execução de uma placa passa ``strict=True``: uma máscara feita a partir de uma imagem da qual uma etapa foi descartada silenciosamente seria apresentada como a máscara que as configurações pediram.

records.source: Matplotlib's toolbar icon engine multiplies the size Qt asks for by the device pixel ratio, and Qt has already done so; above 1 the two cancel, below 1 (a user's ``QT_SCALE_FACTOR`` under 1) they compound. Measured offscreen at a ratio of 0.5: the icons drew 3 px tall instead of 11. Holding the engine's ratio at 1 or more draws them 11 px tall and changes nothing at a ratio of 1 or 2. Idempotent.

records.translation: O mecanismo de ícones da barra de ferramentas do Matplotlib multiplica o tamanho que o Qt pede pela razão de pixels do dispositivo, e o Qt já fez isso; acima de 1, os dois se cancelam, abaixo de 1 (um ``QT_SCALE_FACTOR`` do usuário menor que 1), eles se acumulam. Medido fora da tela com razão 0.5: os ícones eram desenhados com 3 px de altura em vez de 11. Manter a razão do mecanismo em 1 ou mais os desenha com 11 px de altura e não muda nada com razão 1 ou 2. Idempotente.
